flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui pages/Furnish/NoticesTable/FurnishableNotices.ts, route/route.ts, pages/Payment/{PaymentSearch,PaymentSearchResult,PaymentProcess}.ts. No code for the 'pay because the FIN work pass expired' decision. Payment and gateway: see ocmseserviceapi payment (not verified in detail for this story).
note: The story is not in any flow deck; sheet status is 'Fully paid'. Paying the notice is available in the portal (payment route and the 'Make payment' button on the Furnish page), and choosing to pay does not create a furnish application, so the driver details need not be filled. But that button is generic on the notice selection step and is not tied to a decision after the expired FIN work pass message (OCMS42.18 does not exist in code). So the decision step is Sebagian, the same as the pay-choice step in OCMS42.18. Per-notice payment eligibility (payment_acceptance_allowed) and the payment gateway: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim in part. The pay path exists and does not force filling in particulars, but it is not connected to the decision after the expired FIN message.

steps.step: The user indicates the decision to pay the notice instead of continuing the particulars submission (after the expired FIN message)
steps.detail: The 'Make payment' button (id pay-btn) on the notice selection step opens /payment in a new tab (FurnishableNotices.ts:203-208, 222-228). It is always present for all notices and does not appear as a choice after the FIN check, because the FIN expiry message does not exist (OCMS42.18). The fit is the same as the pay-choice step in OCMS42.18 (generic mechanism, Sebagian).

steps.step: The user can proceed to payment of the notice
steps.detail: The routes payment, payment/processing, payment/success and payment/failure are registered (route.ts:15-37) and the Furnish button opens the payment page (FurnishableNotices.ts:203-208), where the user searches for the notice and pays. Sesuai for 'can proceed to payment'. Whether a specific notice may be paid (payment_acceptance_allowed) and the payment gateway result: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The user does not have to furnish the driver's particulars for that notice
steps.detail: The payment button only opens the payment page (window.open) without calling POST /v1/furnishapplication, so no furnish application is created and the driver particulars are not requested (FurnishableNotices.ts:203-208; submit happens only via FurnishSubmissionController.java:66-200).
